response.sql: WITH event_ratio AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.location, AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.event_id, e.location), ranked AS (SELECT event_id, location, avg_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY location ORDER BY CASE WHEN avg_ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, avg_ratio DESC) AS rnk FROM event_ratio) SELECT event_id, location, avg_ratio, rnk AS rank FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY location, rnk;
